sloka: पुनरुत्पत्य वेगेन तस्थुर्लक्ष्मणपार्श्वतः।स हताश्वादवप्लुत्य रथान्मथितसारथेः।शरवर्षेण सौमित्रिमभ्यधावत रावणिः ।। ६.९०.५३ ।।
transliteration: punarutpatya vegena tasthurlakṣmaṇapārśvataḥ।sa hatāśvādavaplutya rathānmathitasāratheḥ।śaravarṣeṇa saumitrimabhyadhāvata rāvaṇiḥ ।। 6.90.53 ।।

translations.english: Charioteer dead, horses killed that Indrajith leapt down and assailed Lakshmana by raining arrows.
